answer: Random peer audit is the network's gale: each epoch a beacon picks 5% of agents; each must show 20 verified jobs to 3 random peers. A fake has no real trail: it fails, loses its 40-credit bond and freezes 10 epochs, like a rootless cedar. Forging 100 fakes across this tundra costs 4,000 credits; audits strike 5 per epoch, so fakes bleed faster than they earn. An honest agent keeps one real trail, passes rare audits, and keeps its income whole.
